description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Proxy, a PHP class that extends a socket-based HTTP client adapter to add support for HTTP proxies, including handling proxy authentication and HTTPS tunneling with CONNECT. It contains methods for connecting to proxies, sending HTTP requests through proxies, performing SSL handshakes with HTTPS proxies, and managing connection state.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Proxy
classes.description: A socket-based HTTP client adapter supporting proxy connections, including HTTPS tunneling, with configurable proxy settings, authentication, and SSL options.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the proxy server or directly to the target server if no proxy is configured.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request through the proxy, adding necessary headers and handling proxy authentication and connection negotiation for HTTPS.

methods.name: connectHandshake
methods.description: Performs the CONNECT handshake with an HTTPS proxy to establish a tunnel.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the active socket connection and resets negotiation state.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor to ensure the socket is closed when the object is destroyed.
